create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass to configure MLIP inference with tf32, activation checkpointing, and precision options
run_inference_settings_default: run inference_settings_default to get default MLIP inference settings with activation checkpointing enabled
run_inference_settings_turbo: run inference_settings_turbo to get optimized settings with tf32, merged MOLE experts, and compilation enabled
run_inference_settings_traineval: run inference_settings_traineval to get settings matching the default training and evaluation configuration
test_guess_inference_settings: test guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name like turbo into an InferenceSettings object
